items.q: How do I book a lesson?
items.a: Find a teacher, pick an open time on their calendar and send a request. The teacher confirms it, and you will get the meeting link before the lesson starts.

items.q: How much does a lesson cost?
items.a: Wisal sets a fixed price for each stage and subject, so the cost does not change from teacher to teacher. You always see the price before you book.

items.q: Is the first lesson really free?
items.a: Yes. Each teacher offers a number of free trial lessons so you can make sure they are the right fit before paying for anything.
Transfer the amount to one of our local accounts and upload the receipt. Once our team verifies it, your wallet is credited and you can book straight away.

items.q: What if I need to cancel?
items.a: You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 24 hours before the lesson. After that the lesson is charged in full.

items.q: Where do the lessons take place?
items.a: On Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, or any link your teacher prefers. There is nothing extra to install from us.
